mapper.sql: D.DISEASE_NO, D.SOURCE_TYPE, D.SOURCE_CODE, D.DISEASE_NAME, D.ENGLISH_NAME, D.CATEGORY, D.DESCRIPTION, D.SYMPTOM_TEXT, D.SOURCE_URL, D.CREATED_AT, D.UPDATED_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRIAL_DISEASE TD WHERE TD.DISEASE_NO = D.DISEASE_NO ) AS RELATED_TRIAL_COUNT
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO DISEASE D USING ( SELECT #{sourceType} AS SOURCE_TYPE, #{sourceCode} AS SOURCE_CODE, #{diseaseName} AS DISEASE_NAME, #{englishName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS ENGLISH_NAME, #{category,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CATEGORY FROM DUAL ) S ON (D.SOURCE_CODE = S.SOURCE_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET D.SOURCE_TYPE = S.SOURCE_TYPE, D.DISEASE_NAME = S.DISEASE_NAME, D.ENGLISH_NAME = COALESCE(S.ENGLISH_NAME, D.ENGLISH_NAME), D.CATEGORY = COALESCE(S.CATEGORY, D.CATEGORY), D.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( DISEASE_NO, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_CODE, DISEASE_NAME, ENGLISH_NAME, CATEGORY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_DISEASE.NEXTVAL, S.SOURCE_TYPE, S.SOURCE_CODE, S.DISEASE_NAME, S.ENGLISH_NAME, S.CATEGORY, SYSDATE, NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE DISEASE SET DESCRIPTION = #{description,jdbcType=CLOB}, SYMPTOM_TEXT = #{symptomText,jdbcType=CLOB}, SOURCE_URL = #{sourceUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE DISEASE_NO = #{diseaseNo}
